name: Basic blocks
description: Defensive movement patterns from the class lesson.
instructions: Use safe spacing. Follow the block direction demonstrated by your teacher.

name: Ready stance
description: Balanced starting position used in the class sequence.
instructions: Hold the position shown by your instructor without forcing your joints.

name: Forward stance
description: Forward stance as demonstrated in the class lesson.
instructions: Set your feet and weight as shown by your teacher; stop if uncomfortable.

name: Forward step
description: Controlled forward step with balance recovery.
instructions: Move one step into clear space and regain balance before continuing.

name: Backward step
description: Controlled backward step with balance recovery.
instructions: Check behind you, move one step, and regain balance before continuing.

name: Side step
description: Controlled side step with safe spacing.
instructions: Check your side space, step laterally, and return to a balanced position.

name: Triangle stepping
description: Introductory triangle movement pattern taught by your instructor.
instructions: Follow your teacher's foot placement slowly; do not cross into another student's space.

name: Strike + stance
description: A class-approved strike coordinated with a stable stance.
instructions: Combine the movement only after each part is practiced separately.

name: Strike + footwork
description: A class-approved strike coordinated with one footwork pattern.
instructions: Practice slowly in a clear area and follow the sequence demonstrated by your teacher.

name: Complete sequence
description: Introductory combination of stance, strike, and footwork.
instructions: Use the teacher-led sequence only. Stop if spacing or balance becomes unsafe.
